Questions:
- Can you enable the Entity Linking feature flag for a pilot cohort (up to 5 seats) for 8 weeks?

Hi Cara — appreciate the clear ask. Happy to support the pilot. High level options so we can pick the cleanest path: 

1) Temporary add-on unlock (recommended for short pilots)
   - We flip the feature flag for the pilot cohort for 8 weeks.
   - Billing: add-on is charged monthly at the list add-on price and prorated by days used.
   - Credit: if you convert to a committed plan within 30 days of pilot end, we apply 50% of the pilot add-on charges as a one-time credit toward the new committed SKU.

2) Tier upgrade (recommended if you expect near-term full rollout)
   - Move to Pro tier for pilot duration, standard monthly billing prorated.
   - If you commit to 12 months post-pilot, we can ladder back pilot months into the commit at negotiated rates.

3) Feature-limited trial (no charge for N days) — product team must approve; typically we reserve this for strategic trials.

Attached is a draft pricing grid with line items for the Entity Linking add-on and sample prorations. Can you confirm which option you'd prefer and the pilot start date? I can loop in Ben for approval on the credit policy if you want the 50% to move to 100% (he has discretion).

Quick ask from procurement POV so Ben has context: what is your pilot budget cap (ballpark)?

Best,

Cara — thanks for the budget clarity. We ran this by Product and Revenue Ops. Final proposal below (numbers inline so finance can sign off quickly): 

Proposal (approved):
- Pilot window: Aug 2 — Sep 26 (8 weeks). Feature flag unlocked for up to 5 seats.
- Billing: Entity Linking add-on list price = $2,000/month per 5-seat cohort. Prorated for 8 weeks = (2,000 * 8/4.345) approx $3,688. We will bill a single prorated invoice at pilot start.
- Credit on conversion: because this is a short, seat-limited pilot, Revenue Ops approved a 100% credit of the pilot add-on charge toward the first quarter of a 12-month committed agreement provided the signed commitment arrives within 30 days of pilot end.
- Contract flow: simple contract amendment (add-on activation + credit term) is sufficient. Lauren will prepare the amendment and a one-line SOW to capture pilot scope. Expect a DocuSign link within 24 hours.
- Technical: Priyom confirms we can enable the flag with 24 hours notice and will provide a short runbook. Attached is a stub for the runbook and the SOW draft.

Next steps for Medisight:
1) Confirm pilot start date (we have Aug 2 tentatively)
2) Procurement review of amendment from Lauren
3) Sign DocuSign to activate and trigger the prorated invoice

I attached the SOW draft and pricing grid for your CFO. If you want, Ben and I can join a 30-min call with your procurement this week to walk through the amendment.

Thanks — excited to get this rolling.
